_comment: Claude Code settings for NixOS configuration - optimized for small models

hooks._comment_pre: PreToolUse hooks run BEFORE tool execution - can block dangerous operations

PreToolUse._comment: Block edits to auto-generated hardware config file
PreToolUse.message: hardware-configuration.nix is auto-generated by nixos-generate-config. Edit configuration.nix or modules/ instead.

PreToolUse._comment: Block edits to flake.lock (managed by 'nix flake update')
PreToolUse.message: flake.lock is auto-managed. Run 'nix flake update' to update inputs.

PreToolUse._comment: Warn about editing common modules that affect all hosts
PreToolUse.message: Editing modules/default.nix affects ALL 4 hosts (zephyr, forge, nexus, sentry). Consider using enable options instead.

hooks._comment_post: PostToolUse hooks run AFTER tool execution - for validation and checks

PostToolUse._comment: Run flake check after any .nix file edit to catch syntax errors early
